_about: waifu_gen.py's character file: three of the anime pack's characters as they were picked (see CHARACTER_DESIGN.md).

characters.face: a beauty mark, a single pearl earring and full glossy lips
characters.outfit: an unbuttoned lace-cuffed blouse over a fitted lilac brocade corset and a faded lilac coat
characters.pose: stands side-on in a fencer's en garde, her rapier pointed straight at the viewer, her other hand raised elegantly behind her
characters.expression: a charming, dangerous, amused smile that enjoys the viewer's discomfort

characters.hair: long straight black hair in a high ponytail tied with a red silk ribbon
characters.face: sharp intelligent eyes behind small round spectacles, a smudge of soot on her cheek and full red lips
characters.outfit: a fitted dark grey dress with rolled sleeves and a low square neckline, a red silk sash, a leather apron with gleaming instruments in its pockets
characters.prop: holds a glinting scalpel up between two fingers beside her face
characters.expression: composed and cool, one eyebrow raised, a faint knowing smile

characters.hair: matted fair hair in a messy short ponytail
characters.face: full pouting lips and hopeful eyes
characters.outfit: the shredded remains of a blue naval jacket with one gold button left over a torn white shirt knotted under her chest
characters.legs: ragged white breeches torn short showing her curvy hips and bare thighs
characters.prop: clutches a bent brass spyglass to her chest
characters.expression: shaken but indignant, cheeks flushed, glaring as if she didn't need rescuing
